issues.title: image.detectImages returns empty results — driver.evaluate() vs evaluateValue() mismatch

sections.label: Reproduction
sections.body: curl -X POST http://localhost:8182/mcp/call-tool -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tool":"image_detectImages","arguments":{"sessionId":"<id>"}}'

sections.label: Expected Behavior
sections.body: Returns list of 588+ detected images from the Wikipedia flags page.

sections.label: Actual Behavior
sections.body: Returns empty array [] with no error.

sections.label: Root Cause Analysis
sections.body: ImageDetector.detect() calls driver.evaluate(DETECTION_SCRIPT) which uses CDP Runtime.evaluate with returnByValue=false. For the large JSON string returned by the detection script (588 img entries), the CDP response's result.value is null when returnByValue is false for non-trivial strings. The CLI eval command uses evaluateValue() (returnByValue=true) which works fine. Fix: change driver.evaluate() to driver.evaluateValue() in ImageDetector.kt:93.

sections.label: Code Pointer
sections.body: browser4-plugins/browser4-images/src/main/kotlin/ai/platon/pulsar/images/service/ImageDetector.kt:detect() line 93 — change driver.evaluate(DETECTION_SCRIPT) to driver.evaluateValue(DETECTION_SCRIPT)

sections.label: AI Suggested Improvement
sections.body:
- Change driver.evaluate(DETECTION_SCRIPT) to driver.evaluateValue(DETECTION_SCRIPT) in ImageDetector.detect()
- Add a unit test that verifies detection returns results when the page has images
- Consider adding a warning log when detection script returns empty/zero results on a page known to have images

issues.title: MCP tool name snake_case/camelCase mismatch breaks dispatch

sections.label: Reproduction
sections.body: Call image_detect_images (snake_case, as advertised by /mcp/tools) via MCP endpoint. The dispatch derives method='detect_images' but executor expects 'detectImages'.

sections.label: Expected Behavior
sections.body: Both image_detect_images and image_detectImages should work.

sections.label: Actual Behavior
sections.body: image_detect_images returns error: 'Unsupported image method: detect_images'. image_detectImages (camelCase, undocumented) works.

sections.label: Root Cause Analysis
sections.body: toMcpToolName() converts camelCase method names to snake_case for MCP tool names. But dispatchToCustomExecutor() derives the method name by simple substring (domain_ prefix removal), producing snake_case that doesn't match the executor's camelCase method keys. The /mcp/tools endpoint advertises snake_case names, which don't work. A reverse lookup from snake_case to camelCase is needed.

sections.label: Code Pointer
sections.body: browser4-rest/src/main/kotlin/ai/platon/pulsar/rest/mcp/controller/MCPToolController.kt:dispatchToCustomExecutor() line ~772 — add snake_case→camelCase reverse conversion before calling executor

sections.label: AI Suggested Improvement
sections.body:
- In dispatchToCustomExecutor(), convert snake_case method name back to camelCase before passing to executor.callFunctionOn()
- Or add a reverse lookup by checking each toolSpec key against the derived method name using case-insensitive matching
- Add test: verify toMcpToolName() round-trips correctly through the dispatch path for all registered tool executors

issues.title: image.download fails with 'Network is unreachable' from OkHttp

sections.label: Reproduction
sections.body: curl -X POST http://localhost:8182/mcp/call-tool -d '{"tool":"image_download","arguments":{"sessionId":"<id>","url":"https://en.wikipedia.org/static/images/icons/enwiki-25.svg"}}'

sections.label: Expected Behavior
sections.body: Image downloads successfully via OkHttp.

sections.label: Actual Behavior
sections.body: All downloads fail with 'IO error: Network is unreachable'. Times out after 30-120 seconds. curl from the same shell succeeds.

sections.label: Root Cause Analysis
sections.body: OkHttp client in ImageDownloader cannot reach external URLs in this environment while system curl and Chrome can. Likely a JVM-level network configuration issue (proxy, DNS, or IPv4/IPv6). The 120-second timeout is excessive — OkHttp default connect timeout is 10s but observed 30-120s suggests retry or DNS resolution delays.

sections.label: Code Pointer
sections.body: browser4-plugins/browser4-images/src/main/kotlin/ai/platon/pulsar/images/service/ImageDownloader.kt — OkHttp client configuration and error handling. Also check ImageAutoConfiguration.kt for OkHttpClient bean setup.

sections.label: AI Suggested Improvement
sections.body:
- Configure OkHttpClient with explicit connect/read timeouts (e.g., 15s) instead of relying on defaults
- Add a connectivity check before attempting downloads and surface a clear error message
- Consider falling back to browser-mediated download (via CDP Network.loadNetworkResource or fetch) when direct HTTP fails
- Log the specific IOException details (DNS failure vs connect timeout vs route) for easier diagnosis

issues.title: Plugin 'inactive (restart required)' status is permanently misleading

sections.label: Reproduction
sections.body:
1. Install plugin: ./b4w.ps1 plugin install <jar>
2. Stop server: ./b4w.ps1 stop
3. Restart and check: ./b4w.ps1 plugin list
Plugin still shows 'inactive (restart required)' even though server logs confirm it's loaded and running.

sections.label: Expected Behavior
sections.body: After server restart, plugin status should show 'active' or 'running'.

sections.label: Actual Behavior
sections.body: Plugin always shows 'inactive (restart required)' in plugin list output, even when server logs confirm: '✓ Registered tool executor for domain image' and 'browser4-images plugin started'.

sections.label: Root Cause Analysis
sections.body: The status string is hardcoded or derived from a condition that never clears. Investigation needed in PluginService or PluginController to understand why the status field doesn't update after a successful plugin load.

sections.label: Code Pointer
sections.body: browser4-rest or browser4-browser-plugin module — PluginService or PluginController where plugin status is computed for the plugin list endpoint

sections.label: AI Suggested Improvement
sections.body:
- Fix the status detection to reflect actual plugin activation state after server startup
- Consider adding a 'status' field to the plugin list JSON output showing actual runtime state (loaded/running/error)
- Add an integration test that installs a plugin, restarts, and verifies the status shows as active

issues.title: No CLI commands for image plugin tools — requires raw MCP HTTP calls

sections.label: Reproduction
sections.body: Try to use image detection from browser4-cli directly. No image, detect-images, or download command exists in the CLI.

sections.label: Expected Behavior
sections.body: CLI commands like `browser4-cli image detect` or `browser4-cli image-download` that wrap the plugin's MCP tools.

sections.label: Actual Behavior
sections.body: Image tools are only accessible via raw HTTP POST to http://localhost:8182/mcp/call-tool with JSON body. Not documented in help output or SKILL.md.

sections.label: Root Cause Analysis
sections.body: Plugin tools are registered as AI agent tools (for LLM use) but not exposed as CLI commands. The CLI-to-backend bridge only maps specific tools to commands; plugin tools need explicit mapping or a generic 'call-tool' CLI command.

sections.label: Code Pointer
sections.body: cli/browser4-cli/src/ — commands registration. A generic 'mcp-call' or plugin-tool CLI command could be added.

sections.label: AI Suggested Improvement
sections.body:
- Add a generic CLI command like `browser4-cli tool <domain>.<method> [args...]` that forwards to /mcp/call-tool
- Or add specific `browser4-cli image detect`, `browser4-cli image download` commands
- Document plugin tool access in SKILL.md
- List available plugin tools in `plugin info <name>` output

issues.title: image.downloadAll returns success with all zeros, masking the detection failure

sections.label: Reproduction
sections.body: Call image.downloadAll on a page with 588 images. Returns success with totalAttempted=0, successful=0, failed=0.

sections.label: Expected Behavior
sections.body: Should return error or at minimum a non-zero attempted count when the page has images.

sections.label: Actual Behavior
sections.body: Returns BulkDownloadSummary with all fields zero (totalAttempted=0, successful=0, failed=0, totalBytesDownloaded=0, results=[]). No error or warning.

sections.label: Root Cause Analysis
sections.body: downloadAll depends on imageDetector.detect() which returns empty list (Issue 1). The empty list propagates silently — no warning when a page with images produces zero detections.

sections.label: Code Pointer
sections.body: browser4-plugins/browser4-images/src/main/kotlin/ai/platon/pulsar/images/tools/ImageToolExecutor.kt:callFunctionOn() lines 165-183 — downloadAll handler

sections.label: AI Suggested Improvement
sections.body: - Add a warning when detect() returns 0 results but driver.pageSource contains tags (quick sanity check) - Consider returning an error or at least logging a warning when downloadAll finds zero images - The BulkDownloadSummary could include a warning field

issues.title: Server restart takes 15+ seconds on every stop/start cycle

sections.label: Reproduction
sections.body: Run ./b4w.ps1 stop followed by any command. Observe 15s startup delay.

sections.label: Expected Behavior
sections.body: Faster server restart (< 5s) or instant plugin hot-reload.

sections.label: Actual Behavior
sections.body: Server startup takes approximately 15 seconds on every cold start. The JVM loading time is the bottleneck.

sections.label: Root Cause Analysis
sections.body: JVM startup + Spring Boot initialization + Chrome browser launch all happen sequentially. Plugin hot-reload could avoid JVM restart.

sections.label: Code Pointer
sections.body: browser4-rest and browser4-browser startup configuration

sections.label: AI Suggested Improvement
sections.body:
- Consider implementing hot-reload for plugin JARs (watch plugins/ directory)
- Add a progress indicator during startup (currently only shows elapsed seconds)
- Cache the JVM process between plugin changes when possible

issues.title: ArgumentNormalizer strips sessionId requiring manual re-add in dispatch

sections.label: Reproduction
sections.body: Any MCP tool call through dispatchToToolExecutor — DefaultArgumentNormalizer.normalize() removes sessionId from args.

sections.label: Expected Behavior
sections.body: Argument normalization should preserve sessionId and other essential parameters.

sections.label: Actual Behavior
sections.body: sessionId is explicitly removed in DefaultArgumentNormalizer (line 19), then re-added manually in dispatchToToolExecutor (lines 713-718). This is error-prone.

sections.label: Root Cause Analysis
sections.body: Design choice to strip sessionId from normalized args since many tool executors don't need it. But custom executors DO need it for WebDriver access. The re-add logic is fragile.

sections.label: Code Pointer
sections.body: browser4-rest/src/main/kotlin/ai/platon/pulsar/rest/mcp/controller/ArgumentNormalizers.kt:19 — DefaultArgumentNormalizer.normalize() sessionId removal

sections.label: AI Suggested Improvement
sections.body:
- Don't strip sessionId in the default normalizer; let individual normalizers decide
- Or pass sessionId separately through the dispatch chain rather than in args
- Add a comment documenting why sessionId is removed and re-added

issues.title: Plugin download error message is unhelpful ('Network is unreachable' after 120s)

sections.label: Reproduction
sections.body: Attempt image.download when OkHttp cannot reach the target URL.

sections.label: Expected Behavior
sections.body: Clear error indicating connectivity issue with a suggested fix (check proxy, firewall, DNS).

sections.label: Actual Behavior
sections.body: Generic 'IO error: Network is unreachable' after a 30-120 second wait. No suggestion for troubleshooting.

sections.label: Root Cause Analysis
sections.body: OkHttp's IOException is passed through without enrichment. No differentiation between DNS failure, connect timeout, or route issues.

sections.label: Code Pointer
sections.body: browser4-plugins/browser4-images/src/main/kotlin/ai/platon/pulsar/images/service/ImageDownloader.kt:250-259 — catch block for IOException

sections.label: AI Suggested Improvement
sections.body:
- Catch specific IOException subclasses (SocketTimeoutException, UnknownHostException, ConnectException) and provide targeted error messages
- Add suggestions: 'Check network connectivity', 'Verify proxy settings in JAVA_OPTS', 'Try using --server flag'
- Reduce default connect timeout from implicit 120s to explicit 15s
